KONKANI MASTER EDUCATIONAL CORPUS — 5,000 EXAMPLES
============================================================

SOURCE FRAMEWORK
----------------
Expanded directly from the supplied six-language Grade 1–12 framework.
Coverage: literacy, pronunciation/phonetics, grammar, syntax, literature,
writing, morals/ethics, EVS, environmental awareness, civic responsibility,
and advanced composition.

SCRIPT / DIRECTION
------------------
Devanagari/काही संदर्भांत Roman; corpus uses Devanagari, left-to-right

STAGES
------
इयत्ता १-५, इयत्ता ६-८, इयत्ता ९-१०, इयत्ता ११-१२

CORPUS DESIGN
-------------
Each example contains:
1. Learning stage
2. Topic
3. Task/instruction
4. Target skill
5. Context
6. Expected response pattern
7. Grammar/linguistic focus
8. EVS/value connection
9. Difficulty progression
10. Evaluation checklist

Important: this is an expanded educational corpus generated from the supplied
framework. It is not a replacement for a specific board's official textbook
or syllabus.


EXAMPLE 0001
--------------
Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता १-५
Topic: रस
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
{topic} आनी पर्यावरणीय जबाबदारी हांचो संबंद सांगात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to रस. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in रस, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

EXAMPLE 0061
--------------
Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता १-५
Topic: रस
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
{topic} आनी पर्यावरणीय जबाबदारी हांचो संबंद सांगात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to रस. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in रस, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता १-५
Topic: नांव आनी सर्वनांव
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
{topic} चेर तीन प्रस्न आनी तांची जापां तयार करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to नांव आनी सर्वनांव. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in नांव आनी सर्वनांव, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Topic: उपसर्ग आनी प्रत्यय
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
{topic} कडेन संबंदीत वाक्य दिल्ल्या काळांत बदलात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to उपसर्ग आनी प्रत्यय. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in उपसर्ग आनी प्रत्यय, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to सायबर नैतिकता. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in सायबर नैतिकता, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता १-५
Topic: वाक्य रचना
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
{topic} ह्या विशयाचेर एक ल्हान परिच्छेद बरयात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to वाक्य रचना. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in वाक्य रचना, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Difficulty: Advanced school: syntax, rhetoric, analysis, formal writing

TASK
----

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to वाक्य रचना. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in वाक्य रचना, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ९-१०
Topic: पत्र लेखन
Difficulty: Advanced school: syntax, rhetoric, analysis, formal writing

TASK
----
{topic} ह्या विशयाचेर एक ल्हान परिच्छेद बरयात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to पत्र लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in पत्र लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------

grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------

sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

--------------------------

TASK
----

CONTEXT
-------

When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------

• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;

• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

TASK
----

When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS

structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------

patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water

ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

------------------------------

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

TASK
----

CONTEXT
-------

language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in विभक्ती, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;

• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

TASK
----

LINGUISTIC FOCUS

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------

patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water

ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

------------------------------

TASK
----

When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

------------

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------

sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------

patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

TASK
----

When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------

structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------

patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

----

patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

TASK
----

from interpretation.

----------------------

patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water

ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

TASK
----

CONTEXT
-------

When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in विभक्ती, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;

• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Konkani
Stage: इयत्ता ११-१२
Topic: खबर लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} कडल्यान मेळपी नैतिक शिकवण स्पश्ट करात.

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to खबर लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in खबर लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level
